title: Flashcards: Ray-finned fishes, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about ray-finned fishes. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Blue Banded Surgeonfish?
cards.explain: The Blue Banded Surgeonfish is Acanthurus lineatus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Bala shark?
cards.explain: The Bala shark is Balantiocheilos melanopterus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Giant barb?
cards.explain: The Giant barb is Catlocarpio siamensis.

cards.explain: The Peters' elephantnose fish is Gnathonemus petersii.

cards.explain: The Common dace is Leuciscus leuciscus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Sea goldie?
